## Summary

Declare CFEL containment operator /

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Operator//Containment == "/"
```

### Prose Claim

`Whole/Part` expresses the immediate `CONTAINS` Relation from Whole to Part. Its corresponding direct `IS_CONTAINED_BY` fact runs from Part to Whole. Containment does not imply narrowing or inheritance.

When directional cardinality slots are present, the slot before `/` counts outgoing `CONTAINS` links per Whole, and the slot after `/` counts reverse `IS_CONTAINED_BY` links per Part. Omitted slots remain unspecified. A Relation declaration or an applicable endpoint permission supplies its own bounds.

## Semantics

`/` expresses immediate containment from a Whole to a Part.

## Summary

Define NARROWER_THAN

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
$narrower ((NARROWER_THAN)) $broader;

Relation//NARROWER_THAN ((HAS_INVERSE)) Relation//HAS_NARROWER;

alias(Relation//NARROWER_THAN) == "//";

Relation//NARROWER_THAN ((HAS_CLASSIFICATION)) Derivation == Direct
```

### Prose Claim

NARROWER_THAN relates a narrower MODEL kind to a broader MODEL kind. A Property does not narrow. Both endpoints are MODEL kinds; Property bearers and instance populations do not become kinds through this notation. The narrower kind inherits applicable Relation and Property constraints without cloning declarations or instance facts. HAS_NARROWER is its derived inverse. In `X//Y`, Y is narrower than X; traversal runs from broader to narrower.

## Summary

Define INSTANCE_OF

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Relation//INSTANCE_OF ((HAS_INVERSE)) Relation//HAS_INSTANCE;

Relation//INSTANCE_OF ((HAS_CLASSIFICATION)) Derivation == Direct;

# instances
$instance ((INSTANCE_OF)) $kind;
```

### Prose Claim

The Host is an instance of the Target declared kind. A Property instance is borne by its data bearer and is an instance of its corresponding model Property, which remains borne by its model bearer. A Property instance has no independent Carrier; its bearer and kind Relations are distinct and may coexist.

Forward `Host ((INSTANCE_OF)) Target` and reverse `Target <((INSTANCE_OF)) Host` are views of the same Relation fact.
INSTANCE_OF relates instance of a declared kind to declared kind.

## Summary

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Relation//CONTAINS <((HAS_INVERSE)) Relation//IS_CONTAINED_BY;

alias(Relation//CONTAINS) == "/"
```

## Semantics

CONTAINS relates a Container to its immediately contained part.
